title: LIT live stop, $800 up to a 40-pt stop + never more than 60% of the room to the max-loss floor
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: upsizing and fewer wide stops - do tighter stops or more contracts pay on LIT?
verdict: Fastest eval with 2-week fails under 10% in both halves (eval-speed mode). 2026 H1 (pick) n=80 3.12/wk win 22.5% PF 4.11 net +44,233 ($7,257/mo) DD -2,982 median stop 44.25 pts, 6.0 micros, $499 at risk; eval 2wk 46.9/5.5 1mo 63.3/18.0 pass rate 75.9% median 6.0; 2026 H2 (check) n=40 2.56/wk win 35.0% PF 2.6 net +14,801 ($3,985/mo) DD -2,403 median stop 51.625 pts, 3.0 micros, $370 at risk; eval 2wk 47.4/5.1 1mo 60.3/15.4 pass rate 74.3% median 8.0; 2021-25 reference only n=510 2.38/wk win 17.5% PF 0.95 net -4,516 ($-88/mo) DD -25,313 median stop 38.125 pts, 3.0 micros, $292 at risk; eval 2wk 13.2/10.7 1mo 18.6/27.6 pass rate 29.4% median 11.0
notes: tools/lit_tightstop.py (wraps engine/lit.py; stop_mode ext + LIT size == run lit_live trade for trade). Same LIT signals and fills; the stop, entry limit or size changes. MFFU $1,000 soft daily loss modelled; NQ minis at $4.50 a round trip.
method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
